QuestInfo.name: Checking on El Nath
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: You must prepare for the Black Mage's imminent return. Go see Alcaster in El Nath.
QuestInfo.2: Alcaster says El Nath was relatively unscathed in the previous war, but he's worried about the next one, since El Nath has grown so much in that time.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 90,000
Can proceed to Checking on the Temple of Time

0.0: Thank you for checking on Henesys. Will you check on the citizens of #bEl Nath#k next?

yes.0: El Nath is an important position. Check with #bAlcaster#k to ensure nothing out of the ordinary is going on.

1.0: What brings you all the way out to El Nath, young Explorer? Are you perhaps interested in tasting my pumpkin pie? Oh, Athena Pierce sent you?
1.1: Tell her that all is well in El Nath. In the last war, 300 years ago, this land was barren and mostly overlooked.
1.2: We've grown since then. Some Explorers have even made El Nath their home. We will not be overlooked the next time war breaks out.

yes.0: As long as humans exist, there will be war. Which is why I bake. It brings peace to my soul.

npc.0: El Nath is an important position. Check with #bAlcaster#k to ensure nothing out of the ordinary is going on.
